articles.title: A top economist thinks Trump's big affordability push will do more harm than good
articles.mainIdea: A top economist thinks Trump's big affordability push will do more harm than good
articles.summary: Business Insider: A top economist thinks Trump's big affordability push will do more harm than good. Mark Zandi told Business Insider that the idea to cap credit card interest would hurt borrowers, while Trump's mortgage plan could raise home prices.

articles.title: Trump's credit card cap could make most of industry 'unprofitable'
articles.mainIdea: Trump's credit card cap could make most of industry 'unprofitable'
articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: Trump's credit card cap could make most of industry 'unprofitable'. JPMorgan Chase (JPM) reached a deal earlier this month to take over Goldman Sachs' (GS) Apple Card (AAPL) account; the costs related to this transfer weighed on the former's earnings figures for the fourth quarter. Additionally, President Trump suggested a 10% cap on credit card fees earlier this week. HSBC Head of US Financials Research Saul Martinez reacts to headlines of the Apple Card impacts and what Trump's policy proposal could mean for the financial sector and credit lenders. Also watch Saul Martinez discuss JPMorgan's latest earnings release. To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts. Related tickers mentioned: AAPL, AXP, BAC, C, COF-PK, COF-PL, COF-PN, JPM, MA, SYF, SYF-PB, WFC, XLF.
